name: qr-command
description: The payment-QR consolidator, read-only, on the phone. Built from the Per-Fin06 master and deployed as a Cloudflare Worker with static assets. Ships twelve fields per account (key, name, brand, payload, acct, maintenance, bank, holder, bankMark, holderMark, tag, ring) and no edit path: the legal name, owner, group and DuitNow member number stay on the laptop.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm test && wrangler deploy
